theory.grammar:
Present Simple vs. Present Continuous:

• Present Simple — diễn tả thói quen, sự thật hiển nhiên.
Ex: My father earns the money in our family.

• Present Continuous — diễn tả hành động đang xảy ra ngay lúc nói.
Ex: Look! Nam is doing the heavy lifting over there.

exercises.question: My mother often ____ (cook) dinner for the family.
Right now, my sister ____ (do) the laundry.
They ____ (go) to the market every Sunday.
My father ____ the money in our family.
Look! Nam ____ the heavy lifting over there.

theory.grammar:
Passive Voice (cơ bản):

• Cấu trúc: S + be + V3/ed + (by O)
• Hiện tại: am/is/are + V3/ed
Ex: Music is played by the band every night.
• Quá khứ: was/were + V3/ed
Ex: That song was composed in 1999.

exercises.question: This song ____ (write) by a famous composer in 2010.
The guitar ____ (play) by my brother every evening.
The concert ____ (hold) at the city hall last week.
Music ____ by the band every night.
That song ____ in 1999.

theory.grammar:
Used to:

• Diễn tả thói quen trong quá khứ (nay không còn).
• Cấu trúc: S + used to + V-inf
Ex: She used to have difficulty reading before learning Braille.
• Phủ định: S + didn't use to + V-inf
• Câu hỏi: Did + S + use to + V-inf?

exercises.question: He ____ (be) very shy when he was a child.
They ____ (not / live) in the countryside before moving here.
____ she ____ (play) the piano when she was young?
She ____ have difficulty reading before learning Braille.
____ she use to play the piano?

theory.grammar:
Present Perfect:

• Diễn tả hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và kéo dài đến hiện tại.
• Cấu trúc: S + have/has + V3/ed
Ex: Scientists have invented many useful devices.
• Dấu hiệu: since, for, already, yet, ever, never, just.

exercises.question: Thomas Edison ____ (invent) the light bulb.
They ____ (already / develop) a new version of the device.
____ you ____ (ever / try) using a 3D printer?
Scientists ____ many useful devices.
____ you ever tried using a 3D printer?

theory.grammar:
Modal verbs: should / must / have to

• Should: nên (lời khuyên)
Ex: Everyone should be treated equally.
• Must: phải (bắt buộc)
Ex: We must stop discrimination.
• Have to: phải (do ngoại cảnh)
Ex: Women have to work harder to prove themselves.

exercises.question: You ____ (should / respect) others regardless of gender.
We ____ (must / eliminate) gender stereotypes.
She ____ (has to / work) twice as hard as her male colleagues.
Everyone ____ be treated equally.
Women ____ work harder to prove themselves.

theory.grammar:
Comparatives and Superlatives:

• So sánh hơn: S1 + be + adj-er/more adj + than + S2
Ex: This custom is more unique than that one.
• So sánh nhất: S + be + the + adj-est/most adj
Ex: Tet is the most important festival in Vietnam.

exercises.question: Vietnamese culture is ____ (rich) than some other cultures.
This is ____ (fascinating) tradition I have ever seen.
Heritage preservation is ____ (important) than tourism.
Vietnamese culture is ____ than some other cultures.
Tet is ____ most important festival in Vietnam.

theory.grammar:
Relative Clauses:

• Who: chỉ người
Ex: Students who study online can learn at their own pace.
• Which: chỉ vật
Ex: The platform which we use is very interactive.
• That: chỉ cả người và vật (trong mệnh đề xác định).

exercises.question: The teacher ____ (who / teaches) online is very experienced.
The course ____ (which / offer) many interactive features is popular.
The student ____ (that / sit) next to me is doing self-study.
Students ____ study online can learn at their own pace.
The platform ____ we use is very interactive.

theory.grammar:
Pronunciation Rules:

• -ed ending:
/ɪd/ sau t, d — wanted, needed
/t/ sau k, p, s, ch, sh — worked, stopped
/d/ các trường hợp còn lại — played, called

• -s/es ending:
/ɪz/ sau s, z, ch, sh, x — watches, boxes
/s/ sau k, p, t, f — looks, stops
/z/ các trường hợp còn lại — plays, words

exercises.question: The word 'watched' has the -ed sound: /t/, /d/, or /ɪd/?
The word 'needed' has the -ed sound: /t/, /d/, or /ɪd/?
The word 'boxes' has the -s sound: /s/, /z/, or /ɪz/?
The word 'watched' has the -ed sound:
The word 'boxes' has the -s sound:

theory.grammar:
Should / Ought to / Had better:

• Should: nên làm gì
Ex: You should listen to your parents' advice.
• Ought to: nên (mạnh hơn should)
Ex: Children ought to respect the elderly.
• Had better: tốt hơn nên (nếu không sẽ có hậu quả)
Ex: You had better finish your homework before going out.

exercises.question: You ____ (should / talk) to your parents about your problems.
Teenagers ____ (ought to / listen) to advice from adults.
You ____ (had better / not / stay) out too late.
You ____ listen to your parents' advice.
Children ____ respect the elderly.

theory.grammar:
Prepositions + V-ing:

• Sau giới từ (in, on, at, of, for, about, ...) động từ thêm -ing.
Ex: She is interested in making new friends.
Ex: They apologized for being late.
• Một số cụm: look forward to, be used to, get used to, can't help, it's no use, ...

exercises.question: He is good ____ (make) friends with strangers.
I look forward ____ (hear) from you.
They apologized ____ (be) late for the party.
She is interested ____ making new friends.
They apologized ____ being late.

theory.grammar:
Conditional Sentences Type 1:

• Diễn tả điều kiện có thật ở hiện tại/tương lai.
• Cấu trúc: If + S + V(s/es), S + will + V-inf
Ex: If we protect the environment, we will have a better future.
Ex: If it rains tomorrow, the game will be cancelled.

exercises.question: If we ____ (plant) more trees, the air ____ (be) cleaner.
If people ____ (stop) polluting, the ecosystem ____ (recover).
If she ____ (recycle) paper, she ____ (help) save forests.
If we ____ more trees, the air will be cleaner.
If it ____ tomorrow, the game will be cancelled.

theory.grammar:
Tag Questions:

• Câu hỏi đuôi: khẳng định — phủ định, phủ định — khẳng định.
Ex: ASEAN has 10 member states, doesn't it?
Ex: Vietnam isn't a member of ASEAN, is it?
Ex: You can speak English, can't you?

exercises.question: ASEAN promotes regional cooperation, ____?
You aren't from an ASEAN country, ____?
They have joined the ASEAN summit, ____?
ASEAN has 10 member states, ____?
You can speak English, ____?

theory.grammar:
Phrasal Verbs (cụm động từ):

• Bring about: mang lại
• Carry out: thực hiện
• Set up: thành lập
• Turn up: xuất hiện
• Look after: chăm sóc

Ex: ASEAN carries out many cultural programs.

exercises.question: The government will ____ (set up) a new trade agreement.
We need to ____ (carry out) more research on this issue.
Bright future will ____ (bring about) positive changes.
The government will ____ a new trade agreement.
We need to ____ more research on this issue.

theory.grammar:
Conditional Sentences Type 2:

• Diễn tả điều kiện không có thật ở hiện tại.
• Cấu trúc: If + S + V2/ed, S + would + V-inf
Ex: If we reduced emissions, the temperature wouldn't rise so fast.
Ex: If I were you, I would use renewable energy.

exercises.question: If people ____ (use) less fossil fuel, the air ____ (be) cleaner.
If I ____ (be) you, I ____ (switch) to solar energy.
The Earth ____ (not / be) so warm if we ____ (stop) deforestation.
If people ____ less fossil fuel, the air would be cleaner.
If I ____ you, I would switch to solar energy.

theory.grammar:
Reported Speech (Câu tường thuật):

• Câu khẳng định: S + said/told + (that) + S + V(lùi thì)
Ex: He said (that) he would apply for a scholarship.
• Câu hỏi Yes/No: S + asked + if/whether + S + V
Ex: She asked if I had a bachelor's degree.
• Lùi thì: hiện tại → quá khứ, will → would, can → could

exercises.question: He said, "I will study abroad." → He said that he ____ study abroad.
She asked, "Do you have a scholarship?" → She asked if I ____ a scholarship.
"I am majoring in Economics," he said. → He said that he ____ in Economics.
He said that he ____ study abroad.
She asked if I ____ a scholarship.

theory.grammar:
Relative Clauses (who / whom / which / that):

• Who: chủ ngữ — chỉ người
Ex: The manager who interviewed me was friendly.
• Whom: tân ngữ — chỉ người
Ex: The person whom I met yesterday is my boss.
• Which: chỉ vật
Ex: The company which offers the best benefits will attract talent.

exercises.question: The woman ____ (who / she) gave me the job is very kind.
The company ____ (which / it) offers internships is hiring.
The colleague ____ (whom / I work with) is very supportive.
The woman ____ gave me the job is very kind.
The company ____ offers internships is hiring.

theory.grammar:
Past Simple vs. Past Continuous:

• Past Simple: hành động đã xảy ra và kết thúc trong quá khứ.
Ex: She graduated in 2015.
• Past Continuous: hành động đang xảy ra tại một thời điểm trong quá khứ.
Ex: At 8 PM yesterday, he was preparing for his speech.
• Kết hợp: When + Past Simple, Past Continuous (hành động ngắn xen vào hành động dài).
Ex: When I arrived, she was giving a presentation.

exercises.question: Yesterday, I ____ (meet) a famous artist.
At 5 PM, she ____ (prepare) for her biography interview.
When I ____ (call) him, he ____ (write) his memoir.
When I arrived, she ____ a presentation.

theory.grammar:
Articles: a / an / the / (no article):

• A/an: danh từ đếm được số ít, nhắc đến lần đầu.
Ex: There is a new hospital in the city.
• The: đã xác định, duy nhất, hoặc nhắc lại.
Ex: The infrastructure needs improvement.
• No article: danh từ số nhiều/không đếm được nói chung.
Ex: Cities attract ∅ migrants from rural areas.

exercises.question: There is ____ university in the city center.
____ infrastructure in big cities must be improved.
Many people move to ____ cities for better opportunities.
There is ____ university in the city center.
____ infrastructure in big cities must be improved.

theory.grammar:
Future Tenses:

• Will: quyết định tức thì, dự đoán không có bằng chứng.
Ex: I think humans will find a solution.
• Be going to: dự định từ trước, dự đoán có bằng chứng.
Ex: Look at the pollution levels! The planet is going to suffer.
• Present Continuous: sắp xếp chắc chắn trong tương lai gần.
Ex: They are launching a new conservation campaign next week.

exercises.question: I believe we ____ (find) a solution to climate change.
They ____ (launch) a recycling program next month.
Look at the melting ice caps! The temperature ____ (rise).
I think humans ____ find a solution.
They ____ a recycling program next month.

theory.grammar:
Passive Voice (nâng cao):

• Hiện tại hoàn thành: have/has been + V3/ed
Ex: The news has been broadcast on all channels.
• Tương lai: will be + V3/ed
Ex: The article will be published tomorrow.
• Động từ khiếm khuyết: modal + be + V3/ed
Ex: Information should be verified before sharing.

exercises.question: The article ____ (write) by a famous journalist.
Fake news ____ (should / avoid) by everyone.
The show ____ (cancel) due to low ratings.
The news ____ on all channels.
Fake news ____ by everyone.

theory.grammar:
Conjunctions: either...or / neither...nor / both...and / not only...but also:

• Either...or: hoặc...hoặc
Ex: You can either preserve or lose your cultural identity.
• Neither...nor: không...cũng không
Ex: Neither language nor customs should be forgotten.
• Both...and: cả...và
Ex: Both traditions and modernity can coexist.

exercises.question: We should ____ preserve ____ promote our cultural heritage.
You can ____ learn from the past ____ embrace the future.
____ language ____ traditions define who we are.
You can ____ preserve ____ lose your cultural identity.
____ language ____ customs should be forgotten.

theory.grammar:
Relative Clauses (defining vs. non-defining):

• Defining: xác định — không có dấu phẩy, không thể bỏ.
Ex: Animals that are poached may become extinct.
• Non-defining: bổ sung — có dấu phẩy, có thể bỏ.
Ex: Elephants, which are the largest land animals, are endangered.

exercises.question: The species ____ (that / are found) in this forest are rare.
The tiger, ____ (which / is the largest cat), is endangered.
Poachers ____ (who / hunt) illegally should be punished.
Animals ____ are poached may become extinct.
Elephants, ____ are the largest land animals, are endangered.

theory.grammar:
Adverbial Clauses of Concession:

• Although / Even though / Though: mặc dù
Ex: Although the economy faced difficulties, reforms helped it recover.
• Despite / In spite of: mặc dù (có + N/V-ing)
Ex: Despite initial challenges, the reforms succeeded.
Ex: The country grew in spite of global recession.

exercises.question: ____ the reforms were difficult, they brought prosperity.
____ (despite) the challenges, the economy grew steadily.
____ (even though) inflation was high, exports increased.
____ the reforms were difficult, they brought prosperity.
____ initial challenges, the reforms succeeded.

theory.grammar:
Conditional Sentences Type 3:

• Diễn tả điều kiện không có thật trong quá khứ.
• Cấu trúc: If + S + had + V3/ed, S + would/could + have + V3/ed
Ex: If we had invested in technology, we would have created more jobs.
Ex: If he had taken that job, he would have earned more.

exercises.question: If we ____ (invest) in automation, we ____ (not / lose) those jobs.
If she ____ (accept) the offer, she ____ (work) for a multinational company.
They ____ (succeed) if they ____ (follow) the business plan.
If we ____ in technology, we would have created more jobs.
If he ____ that job, he would have earned more.
